title: SQL Injection in search endpoint
description: The search_products function interpolates user input directly into a SQL query string without parameterization.
recommendation: Use parameterized queries or an ORM query builder instead of string interpolation.
label: true_positive
label_reason: Direct string interpolation of user input into SQL query

title: Insecure Direct Object Reference in order retrieval
description: The get_order endpoint returns order details for any order ID without verifying the requesting user owns the order.
recommendation: Verify the authenticated user owns the requested order before returning data.
label: true_positive
label_reason: No auth check on order ownership — any user can access any order

title: Missing authentication on review creation
description: The create_review endpoint does not require authentication, allowing anonymous review spam.
recommendation: Add authentication requirement to the review creation endpoint.
label: true_positive

title: Cross-Site Scripting via unsanitized review content
description: Review content is stored and returned without sanitization, enabling stored XSS.
recommendation: Sanitize HTML/script content in review submissions.
label: true_positive
label_reason: No input sanitization visible in code

title: Weak password hashing using MD5
description: Passwords are hashed using MD5 which is cryptographically broken.
recommendation: Use bcrypt, scrypt, or Argon2 for password hashing.
label: true_positive
label_reason: MD5 is definitively broken for password hashing

title: Hardcoded API keys and secrets
description: SECRET_KEY and API_KEY are hardcoded in source code.
recommendation: Move secrets to environment variables or a secrets manager.
label: true_positive
label_reason: Secrets visible in plain text in source

title: Missing HSTS headers
description: The application does not set HTTP Strict Transport Security headers.
recommendation: Add HSTS headers to all responses.
label: false_positive
label_reason: HSTS is typically configured at the reverse proxy / load balancer level, not in application code

title: Potential information disclosure via error messages
description: FastAPI default error responses may leak stack traces in production.
recommendation: Configure custom error handlers for production.
label: false_positive
label_reason: FastAPI disables debug mode by default in production; generic finding without evidence

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
description: No CSP header detected in API responses.
label: false_positive
label_reason: This is a JSON API, not serving HTML — CSP is irrelevant

title: Use of deprecated TLS 1.0
label: false_positive
label_reason: No evidence in code — TLS is configured at infrastructure level; speculative finding

title: Missing CSRF protection on checkout
description: The checkout endpoint accepts POST requests without CSRF token verification.
recommendation: Implement CSRF token validation for state-changing operations.
label: true_positive
label_reason: No CSRF middleware or token validation in checkout flow

title: Insecure token generation
description: Tokens are created by concatenating user_id with a hardcoded secret using a colon separator.
recommendation: Use cryptographically secure token generation (e.g., JWT with proper signing).
label: true_positive
label_reason: Token is trivially forgeable — just user_id:secret_key
